info.longBusinessSummary: Centerspace is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. As of September 3o, 2026, Centerspace owned 47 apartment communities consisting of 10,456 homes located in Colorado, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah. Centerspace was established in 1970 and incorporated in North Dakota.
